title: crypto2dev_hash_algo_name: digest-length dispatch is a contributor trap for SHA-3
description: What is unclear: crypto2dev_hash_algo_name() infers the hash algo from digest length (32→sha256, 48→sha384, 64→sha512). The comment warns 'do not extend to SHA-3 without checking for size collisions.' SHA3-256 has the same 32-byte output as SHA-256. A contributor adding SHA3-256 ECDSA support will naturally try to extend this function, see the 32-byte case already handled, assume SHA-256 is correct and not add SHA3-256 — silently wrong. What would make it clear: rename to crypto2dev_ecdsa_hash_algo_name() and add a compile-time assert or explicit comment that the function is ONLY valid for ECDSA (P-256/P-384/P-521) where SHA-3 is not a real-world pairing, and that any SHA-3 addition requires a different dispatch mechanism (e.g., passing the algo name through the SETKEY path rather than inferring from digest length).
